meta.scope: Paraguay batch 6 — Deep international trade architecture, investment treaties, industrial promotion regimes (updated Law 60/90 → 7548/2025, automotive policy, free zones), and commercial instruments. Focused poke at deals and industrial/commercial side.

candidates.title: Ley 7548/2025 — Nuevo régimen de incentivos fiscales para la inversión
candidates.description: Updated general investment-promotion law (successor to Law 60/90). Grants tax and customs benefits for declared national and foreign investment projects.
referenced_by: Project-approval documentation under the new regime
candidates.notes: Core horizontal investment-incentive framework. Replaced Law 60/90 in September 2025. Continuously cited alongside the maquila regime as a primary reason firms locate in Paraguay. (Supersedes the earlier py-ley-60-90 node conceptually; keep both for lineage if needed.)

candidates.title: Acuerdos de Promoción y Protección de Inversiones (APPI / BITs)
candidates.description: Network of bilateral investment treaties (25+ countries). Provides legal protection and, in some cases, national-treatment guarantees for foreign investors.
referenced_by: US State Department and other investment-climate statements
candidates.notes: Core legal infrastructure for FDI. Counterparties include Germany, Spain, France, UK, USA, Chile, Korea, Taiwan, UAE and others, plus the MERCOSUR investment framework.

candidates.title: Política Automotriz / ACE 13 sector automotor
candidates.description: Automotive-sector policy and the bilateral ACE 13 regime with Argentina governing preferential trade in vehicles and auto parts, including regional-content rules and quotas.
referenced_by: MIC origin-certification guidance for auto parts
candidates.notes: Sector-specific industrial and trade instrument. ACE 13 with Argentina remains the operational preferential framework for vehicles and auto parts; Law 4838/12 provides domestic tax benefits for automotive investment.

candidates.title: Consejo Nacional de Industrias Maquiladoras de Exportación (CNIME)
candidates.description: Governing body of the maquila regime. Approves programmes, monitors operations and publishes sector statistics.
candidates.notes: Institutional parent of the maquila system. Continuously cited in maquila export, employment and programme-approval statistics (~35k direct jobs; exports in the USD 1+ bn range).

candidates.title: Consejo Nacional de Zonas Francas (CNZF)
candidates.description: Governing body of the free-zone regime under Law 523/95. Supervises concessions and the special tax/customs treatment (0.5% single tax on third-country exports).
candidates.notes: Institutional parent of the free-zone system. Complements the maquila regime; large-scale projects (e.g. pulp/industrial) have used free-zone concessions.

candidates.title: Acuerdo de Cooperación Económica Paraguay–Taiwán
candidates.description: Bilateral economic-cooperation and preferential-trade instrument with Taiwan. Includes agricultural, technological and investment-promotion elements.
candidates.notes: Distinctive bilateral instrument outside the MERCOSUR external agenda. Continuously listed in official trade-agreement inventories.

candidates.title: Acuerdo de Libre Comercio MERCOSUR–Israel
candidates.description: Free-trade agreement between MERCOSUR and Israel providing preferential access for a large share of bilateral trade.
candidates.notes: Extra-regional preferential instrument. Complements the broader MERCOSUR external agenda (EU, EFTA, Singapore, etc.).

candidates.title: Acuerdo de Libre Comercio MERCOSUR–Egipto
candidates.description: Free-trade agreement between MERCOSUR and Egypt providing preferential access, particularly relevant for agro-industrial exports.
candidates.notes: Extra-regional preferential instrument opening an African market for Paraguayan agro-industrial products.

candidates.title: Inversión Extranjera Directa / FDI statistics
candidates.description: Statistics of foreign direct investment flows and stocks by sector and country of origin. Published as part of the external accounts and specialised BCP studies.
candidates.notes: Core FDI statistical product. Cumulative net inflows on the order of USD 10 bn over 2008–2024; recent flows concentrated in non-financial services (commerce, telecoms, transport, real estate) alongside manufacturing and agro-industry.

candidates.title: Ley 5542/2015 — Invariabilidad de la tasa impositiva
candidates.description: Law allowing tax-rate invariability (stability) for up to 20 years for qualifying investment projects. Complements the general investment-incentive regime.
candidates.notes: Stability instrument that reduces fiscal-policy risk for long-horizon investments. Continuously cited alongside Law 7548/2025 and the maquila/free-zone regimes.

proposed_edges.basis: REDIEX promotes and channels applications under the updated investment-incentive regime.
The BIT network is a core legal foundation cited in investment-promotion materials.
CNIME is the governing body that approves and monitors maquila programmes.
CNZF supervises the free-zone regime under Law 523/95.
ACE 13 and the automotive policy structure preferential trade and origin rules for vehicles and auto parts.
The Taiwan agreement underpins preferential bilateral trade and cooperation.
The Israel FTA expands preferential extra-regional market access.
FDI flows appear in the financial account of the balance of payments.
Tax-rate invariability complements the general investment-incentive regime for long-horizon projects.
